rule.description: A non-bound function threads two or more of the cohesive schema field-selection options {only, exclude, load_only, dump_only} as separate parameters instead of a single encapsulated value.

checks.description: Detect non-bound free functions that take two or more of the cohesive field-selection group {only, exclude, load_only, dump_only} as separate parameters.
checks.detected_relation: free function -> separate cohesive field-selector parameters
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The homogeneous field-name collections only/exclude/load_only/dump_only share the schema/nested selection lifetime; threading them as individual parameters through each helper decomposes the cohesive group at every boundary instead of carrying it as one value.

matches.evidence: flatten_top_selectors(only, exclude, set_factory) takes the only/exclude pair as separate parameters to flatten dotted nested field names.
prefixed_nested_selectors(load_only, dump_only, name) takes the load_only/dump_only pair as separate parameters to prefix-pull selectors from the root.
build_nested_schema_kwargs(many, only, exclude, name, load_only, dump_only) takes all four cohesive selectors as separate parameters to assemble nested-schema init kwargs.
merge_nested_selection(nested_schema, only, exclude, set_factory) takes the only/exclude pair as separate parameters to intersect/union them onto a copied nested schema.

excluded.reason: bound instance method (first parameter self) that owns the selectors through the object; the rule skips self-bound methods.
bound property/attribute of the Nested field; accesses only/exclude/load_only/dump_only through self, so the object already encapsulates them.
